answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 146818 Country: India Title: Which one is right? (1) Salaam Alaikum. (2) Assalaam alaikum. Question: Which one is right? (1) Salaam Alaikum. (2) Assalaam alaikum. Answer ID: 146818 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 290/241/B=3/1438) It is correct to say Assalamu Alaikum ( السلام عليكم ); it is not correct to pronounce Salamu Alaikum ( سلام عليكم ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
